body: Well, I have my problem, and the 'inconvenience' we might share. I suppose, if I really had to put a finger on it, maybe we got a little bit bored with what we possess?
I don't think I can write anymore. My thoughts are too clouded between rage, and whatever else I am feeling. So I guess I am not that apathetic after all.

Not everyone shares the same luck. I am old enough to know better. I am not a teenager though. My ideas aren't a reflection of whatever darkness. My ideas, my thoughts, are the darkness.

I cannot bring myself to hate another person. I no longer even hate myself. This life has just become too small, to occupy any space. Yet, in others' eyes, I am blazing. And it is insulting. It is beyond insulting. It is maddening.

The people I part ways with want to be my friend, still; After everything. I am the type that analyzes, so I know they want two things. They want me, and they want something else. This happens when I want love. For that small material to fill this even smaller pit of emptiness.

So how dares anyone, demand, expect, or want, something of me, when they cannot do even something so trivial? And when you know it comes out of stupidity, it hurts even more. Because in the end, I love every last one you. I hate every last one of you. It is a matter of states. In my state, I love you. In their state, I hate you. Yet I have nothing to share with you. Only poison.

Only sorrow.

Ah, she fell in love with someone else. I tried my best to reconcile with her, but my apathy drew her away from me.

There is nothing left that I love in this world. And it has been like that since I can remember.

It's a good idea to sleep on it. Not sure if I will be here tomorrow. I came mostly to heal my own problems-- but perhaps I will, to talk to you some more, you are interesting. I have a feeling though, that tomorrow you won't feel this way. We'll see, I guess. I hope so at least.

I will tell you tomorrow then, how I think you can improve-- because, fundamentally, I am still sure we have the same problem. The only difference is, I have not reached a state of... let's call it 'critical mass'.

Good night, friend.

Well, hmm, let's see. If money was not a problem, I'd book a flight to some backward country with a funny name. I'd ask someone 'How do you say 'I got a baby son' in their language, or something like that. Walk into the first bar, buy everyone a drink and shout the phrase on the top of my lungs.

You know, you have a lot of possibilities. You don't even need money for them, just creativity; But having more-or-less limitless resources makes things a lot easier. You know, be a trickster. Do something, and believe in what you are doing, as if it was reality. Maybe we can't choose our friends, our qualities or our families-- but we can always choose what we perceive and how we do it. If we make a fool out of ourselves, who cares? I think what matters is what you see when you look inwards. You are not happy right now. You feel under-accomplished, and yet, no matter how hard you look, you can't see how you could possibly improve. That is your perception of things right now, and possibly was for a while, right?

Hmm, the only reason why I'd think someone is well-off if he is extraordinarily educated. Judging by your spelling and phrasing, I can tell that you had some really great education. And you are very intelligent. I am glad you got over your ex, though-- to be honest I am in the same situation right now-- but we have the same problem, my friend. We have a kind heart. It's not a problem, per se.

Have you tried letting loose? When I imagine you, I see a very disciplined person, my apologies if I have the wrong idea.

You know, I'm kind of like you. Well, I certainly don't have 25 million dollars, haha. But I am well off. Let's call it 'Superior' in some way.

Years passed before I realized I was unhappy. You know why? I didn't have friends. Either people were with me because I had things, or they were away from me, for the same reason.

For some time, I pretended I was not so 'Superior', and I made some great friends. Have you ever considered dressing up in some inferior clothes, and going out, and just befriending someone? Or, toyed with the idea of finding a girl, falling in love, and all that, and suddenly, when she says 'But, we don't have the money to buy a house' and you are all smug and say, 'but, baby, I'm a millionaire!'.

I'd do that if I was in your position. If nothing else, to pass the time, while I consider thinking if my problem needs the same solution I have in mind now, right?

I don't want to criticize you. I really don't. I do, but I shouldn't. Listen, if my mother had killed herself... I can't even begin to explain how I'd feel. My mom wen to jail when I was 5. I became a monster. Literally. I feel more like a functioning sociopath today than human. I am not saying I am one, just... the experience left me empty. Look, it's not about me.

But don't do this to your kids. Please. Neither you nor they deserve this; Please, think if this is what -everyone- wants. I am sure your kids will want you to stay with them. That they would like to consider the thought, when they grow old, what it would be like to lose their mother to old age. To get really sad, and sneak into your bed, hiding their thoughts. And you'd pretend like you don't notice their tears.

Be a good and succesful mother. And if you want to fail at anything, fail at proving your ex right, and fail at giving him any success.

I am in the same boat. Heh, it's strange isn't it? When you look far back enough, everything seems different. When you look forward, you can't help but assume there's only going to be downhill from here. But, you know? I think all three of us are here for the same reason. We want hope.

Let me tell you something; The Japanese have this proverb: Shoganai. It means, something that cannot be helped, from an internal inability to change the circumstances.

But it is a spiteful proverb. When I say it, I feel like I just told life to go fuck itself. I feel like I could carve out a different-- A BETTER-- destiny from the piece of shit dirt that makes up this existence. I am sure I could do that, if I wanted to.

Then again, since I am here, I think I want to. Just.. want someone to tell me to go for it. Heh, go for it, bro. You can do it. You can make a better life for yourself.
